Connect GTAPViz to Your AI App (One-Time Setup)

Source: R/mcp_install.R
mcp_install.Rd

Registers the GTAPViz MCP server with an AI app so you can ask the AI, in plain language, to load your GTAP results and create figures and tables. Run it once, then fully quit and reopen the AI app.

After that you can ask, for example: "Use GTAPViz to load the example data and plot welfare (EV) and real GDP by region."

Usage

mcp_install(
  client = c("claude_desktop", "claude_code", "cursor", "other"),
  allow_r_code = FALSE,
  output_dir = NULL,
  config_path = NULL
)

Arguments

client

Character. The AI app to set up:

  • "claude_desktop" (default): writes the Claude Desktop configuration file.

  • "claude_code": registers the server with the Claude Code CLI (user scope).

  • "cursor": writes ~/.cursor/mcp.json.

  • "other": prints the settings to paste into any other MCP-capable app (VS Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Windsurf, ...). Same as mcp_config().

allow_r_code

Logical. If TRUE, the AI may also run arbitrary R code in the GTAPViz session for custom data manipulation. Default FALSE.

output_dir

Character or NULL. Default folder for figures, tables and the session script. If NULL, outputs go next to the input data.

config_path

Character or NULL. Path to the app's configuration file if it is not in the standard location.

Value

Invisibly, the path(s) of the configuration file(s) written (or the server settings for client = "other").

Details

The configuration starts Rscript from this R installation and runs mcp_serve(). Your R, GTAPViz and data stay on your computer; no account, API key or server of the package author is involved. An existing configuration file is backed up (.backup) before it is changed, and other servers in it are kept.

Requirements: R and GTAPViz installed on the same computer as the AI app. Users do not need to know R; the AI writes and runs the code and saves it as a reproducible script (gtapviz_session.R).

See also

mcp_config(), mcp_serve()

Author

Pattawee Puangchit

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Claude Desktop
GTAPViz::mcp_install()

# Claude Code or Cursor
GTAPViz::mcp_install("claude_code")
GTAPViz::mcp_install("cursor")

# Any other MCP app: print the settings to paste
GTAPViz::mcp_install("other")
} # }
